verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm Stripe serves an llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt (with agent-directed instructions) and Markdown versions of doc pages (e.g., payments.md). Stripe also publishes a keyless machine-readable skills index at /.well-known/skills/index.json, and its docs tell coding agents to read .md pages directly. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using these llms.txt/.md docs in practice, and no evidence of what the full llms.txt index covers beyond its opening line.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.stripe.com/llms.txt # Stripe Documentation
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://docs.stripe.com/payments.md # Payments
GET https://docs.stripe.com/.well-known/skills/index.json returns HTTP 200 with 8 Stripe-maintained agent skills
Docs ship a one-prompt coding-agent path ("Read https://docs.stripe.com/payments/machine/mpp.md?lang=node, and monetize my API using MPP to charge 0.50 USD per API call.
Your agent can inspect the full CLI documentation with `link-cli --llms-full`
